I have another personal matter. I have a friend in town, Oleg. He's a retired captain, such a great man! A real fighter, you and I would never reach his greatness. And what a patriot! The problem is that I haven't heard from him for a while now. I'm worried about him. Will you check on him?}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 15 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate the apartment of Prapor's friend on [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Survive and extract from the location ==Rewards== * +7,300 [[EXP]] *[[Prapor]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 42,000 Roubles ** 44,100 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 48,300 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka]] {{quote|No one's in the apartment and there's blood on the floor? Maybe the blood isn't his... And the belongings, are his things still there? Oh boy, he sure wouldn't leave the insignia behind. If you only knew how much he cared about it. So he must be gone. Let us remember him.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to find the apartment of Prapor's friend on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. It is located on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building and can only be accessed via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5.
